reviews.comments: Very cozy place that was easy to get to and nicely located in Dublin 7. Hostess was very helpful with the check-in and always easy to reach.

Teresa's room was different from what we expected. A bit smaller than what the pictures portrayed. Everything in the house was just barely okay. Everything worked, but it was either a bit dirty or barely falling apart. The bathroom was also a bit dirty and tiny. The house itself is a 20-minute walk from the centre. If you don't like walking, it has a bus stop almost in front of the house. The house is okay if you're there for a weekend and want a cheap option.

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist für Dublin Preise in Ordnung, 20 Minuten ins Zentrum zu Fuß. Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist allerdings extrem schlecht. Die Teppichboden im Treppenhaus und in den Schlafzimmern oben sind alt und vergammelt. Im Bad gibt es verschimmelte Dichtfugen. In der Beschreibung der Unterkunft wurde nicht erwähnt, dass die Schlafzimmer oben im 1. Stock sind. Es führt eine enge, steile Treppe nach oben. Das Bad ist allerdings unten im EG und ganz klein. Die Gegend ist eher unangenehm, schmutzig und wirkt trostlos, allerdings sind es zum Zentrum nur 20 Minuten zu Fuß und die Zimmer sind ruhig gelegen. Da man in Dublin nichts unter 100 €/Nacht findet, gehört diese Unterkunft zu den günstigeren, aber für das Geld wird leider gar nichts geboten und es wird leider auch nichts von den Besitzern investiert, was zu einem angenehmeren Aufenthalt und einer besseren Bewerung beitragen könnte.

localizedReview.comments: The location of the accommodation is fine for Dublin prices, 20 minutes to the center on foot. However, the value for money is extremely poor. The carpeting in the stairwell and in the bedrooms upstairs is old and rotten. The bathroom has moldy sealing joints. The listing description did not mention that the bedrooms are upstairs on the 1st floor. There is a narrow, steep staircase to the top. However, the bathroom is downstairs on the ground floor and very small. The area is rather unpleasant, dirty and looks bleak, but it is only a 20-minute walk to the center and the rooms are in a quiet location. Since you can't find anything under €100/night in Dublin, this place is one of the cheaper ones, but unfortunately nothing is offered for the money and unfortunately nothing is invested by the owners, which could contribute to a more pleasant stay and a better review.

reviews.comments: Location is very well, walkable to the city center, and overall the home has everything we needed, BUT the big minus was that house was freezing cold and it never heats up. The heating was active a few hours during the evening but when we wake up we usually needed to get a hoody to go to bathroom, haha. Maybe we are too soft, but I don't recommend it during the fall/winter months. All the other things were all good!

住进来之前有在Googlemaps上搜地址，看到地图上对面的红砖房吓了一跳，还以为是到了农村，到了现场后才知道当地的装修风格多是如此，房子地段不错，市中心但是又是街道里面的位置，路口就是两个公交站台，这样既方便交通也保证了隐私和噪音，房子是两室共用一个卫生间，隔音效果不是很好，不过我住的时候除了第一天后面都隔壁房间没有人所以还是很舒服的，房子的基本设施都有，超赞的是还有烘干机，面对这种天天下雨的天气回来赶紧把衣服烘干很便利，房主也很好沟通不会催人，有什么事情提前沟通也会很好的处理，不过有几个小注意事项，第一个是不同于国内的每层都有卫生间的格局，这个房子的卫生间在一楼，房间都在二楼，所以需要备好东西再下楼去洗漱，不然就会来来回回跑，第二个是浴室洗完后需要自己拿墙上的刮子刮掉水渍，这个我ok的，因为我没有用过觉得还蛮新奇，如果介意的朋友需要注意一下。
总之还蛮推荐住的，就是不建议天气冷的时候来玩，衣服穿的多很累又不好拍照，九月底的爱尔兰真的太冷了 ，刮风还下雨o(╥﹏╥)o

localizedReview.comments:
Before you enter, the address is searched on Googlemaps. I saw the red brick house opposite the map. I thought it was in the countryside. I realized how much the local decoration style was when I arrived at the scene. The house was in a good location, the center of the city, but also the location of the street, the intersection is two bus stations, so that both convenient transportation and privacy and noise are guaranteed. The house is a two-room shared bathroom. The sound insulation effect is not very good, but when I stayed in the next room behind the first day, there is no one in the next room, so it is still very comfortable, the basic facilities of the house are also superb, there is also a dryer. It is very convenient to come back and dry your clothes in the face of this rainy weather. It is very convenient to dry your clothes. The owner is also very good to communicate in advance. It is different from the layout of the bathroom on each floor in the country. The bathroom of this house is on the first floor, the room is on the second floor, so it needs to be ready to go downstairs to wash up, otherwise you will come back and forth. The second is you need to take the scrape on the wall and scrape off the water damage after the bathroom. This is ok, because I didn't use it to feel quite new.
Anyway, it's pretty much recommended to stay, it is not recommended to come and play when it is cold, the clothes are very tired and not good to take photos, the end of September Ireland is really too cold, the wind is still raining╥ o (╥) o

reviews.comments: I stayed for two nights and it was okay. Some expectation management: Location is superb. Lots of shops and restaurants in proximity, you can explore all of Dublin on foot from here. Neighborhood is very quiet; however, you share the house with another guest and their room is right next to yours. Plus, since the house is rather old, you hear almost everything the other guest is doing. Luckily, the other guest was very nice and considerate. There was a very humid smell on my first night, likely due to the weather, but this improved. Both guest rooms are on the upper floor, bathroom is on the lower floor. Cleanliness was okay, but lacked attention to detail.

The house was easy to find and get into. 10 minute walk to the spire and close to the local bus stop. The room was clean and homey. I arrived at 9am and Teresa accommodated my early arrival and had the room prepared early. The amenities were a plus. Overall good stay.
Teresa is a friendly and very accommodative host. Her place is beautiful and well located. Nothing to complain about.

The position is really good, it's a nice residential area close to the city centre and we always walked everywhere. The apartment is small but cozy, the kitchen was fully equipped, even thought it could have been cleaner. Good value for money!
